Cox went into hiding in the United States on April 16, 1970. His memoir then describes waiting about two weeks before obtaining a passport and departing via London and Paris for Algiers. Overseas exile began later in 1970, not on the day he went into hiding; the precise departure date remains unverified. He remained abroad until his death on February 19, 2011.
